skills.name: Composite - Dig soil with a digging tool
skills.description: Use a digging tool to dig soil, create a hole, trench or tunnel.

steps.activity: Position the digging_tool on the soil
Push the digging tool into the soil
steps.category: Pull or push an object with arm

steps.activity: Pull the digging tool out of the soil
steps.category: Pull or push an object with arm

steps.activity: Swing the digging tool to remove soil from the hole, trench or tunnel
steps.category: Swing arm while holding an object

examples: Dig a trench with a shovel
Dig a tunnel beneath a walkway with a drain spade
